full_page.content:
1954, May 4
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed draft of the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Huntington, Indiana
Blessed be God in all His designs! May 4th 1954.
Mr. Philip Leslie. 1929 E. Palm Kane Phoenix Arizona.
God bless you and yours.
I was pleased to receive your pathetic communication. I regret (in a way) that IT is impossible to go into details such as a letter of that nature and gravity would naturally hope for. However, God has given you perhaps more than ordinary faith and intelligence. If that be the case as is probable, then it ought not to be too hard for you to adjust and evaluate and to readjust the temporal and the eternal. I am certainly pleased with your letter in general, and it would look hopeful that your Emmie's influence on you will be for good. Never theless it seems to me if he were earnest about the one thing that ought to be first in every thinker's head, he would know long before this where to look for and to find, the peace that is the life and the heaven of every rational creature, viz; he would know positively by this time, something of the greatest science of all ages and places and would appreciate it as the very life of his soul.
